map.含水率测不准怎么办？: What if the moisture reading is inaccurate?
map.含水率直接影响重量与贮藏安全。同一堆粮，20% 水和 14% 水『干物质』一样但: Moisture directly affects both weight and storage safety. The same pile of grain has the same dry matter at 20% and at 14% moisture but weighs very differently, so the standard moisture content keeps trade fair.
map.在农产品含水率与干物质含量间互算，输入初重与含水率得干物质重，适用于粮储保管、收: Convert between agricultural moisture content and dry matter, taking the initial weight and moisture to get the dry matter weight, which suits grain storage, purchase pricing and raw material accounting.
map.干物质 = 鲜重 × (1 − 含水率)；含水率 = 1 − 干物质/鲜重。: Dry matter = fresh weight x (1 - moisture content); moisture content = 1 - dry matter / fresh weight.
map.按标准含水率折算贸易与仓储计量。: Convert trade and storage measurement to the standard moisture content.
map.用 105℃ 恒重烘干法为仲裁标准，速测仪（电容/近红外）需定期用烘干法校准，尤: The 105°C constant-weight oven method is the arbitration standard, and quick meters (capacitance / near infrared) must be calibrated against the oven method regularly, especially in the high-moisture range where the error is large.
map.用于粮食、饲草的公平计价与贮藏设计。: Used for fair pricing and storage design of grain and forage.
map.：收购鲜重 1000 kg、实测含水率 20%，则干物质 = 1000 × (1: : purchasing 1000 kg fresh weight with a measured moisture of 20%, the dry matter is 1000 x (1 - 0.20) = 800 kg; the "standard 14% basis" needs a further conversion: the standard dry basis is unchanged, and the standard wet weight = 800/(1-0.14) ≈ 930 kg, so about 930 kg at the 14% standard moisture.
